claim: Health is launching to U.S. users and can connect Apple Health and supported medical records.
quote: You can choose to securely connect Apple Health and supported medical records

claim: The launch post describes the rollout as being to logged-in users 18 and older in the U.S. on web and iOS across Free, Go, Plus and Pro.
quote: We’re beginning to roll out Health to logged-in ChatGPT users 18 and older in the U.S. on web and iOS across Free, Go, Plus, and Pro plans today.

claim: Health is not yet available in Codex.
quote: Health is not yet available in Codex.

claim: The launch post names Apple Health, U.S. hospital system records, One Medical and Function Health as connectable sources.
quote: you can choose to connect Apple Health, supported medical records from U.S. hospital systems, One Medical, or Function Health

claim: Launch post: synced Apple Health and medical records, and conversations that use them, are not used to train foundation models regardless of the model-training setting.
quote: Connected medical records and Apple Health information, and conversations that use it, are not used to train our foundation models or target ads, regardless of the model-training setting you choose for ChatGPT.

claim: Launch post: by default ChatGPT asks for permission before using connected records and Apple Health to personalize a response.
quote: By default, ChatGPT asks for permission before using connected medical records and Apple Health information to personalize a response.

claim: Launch post: you can approve each request or always allow access, which turns off the prompts.
quote: You can approve each request or choose to always allow access, which turns off these permission prompts.

claim: Launch post: memory can be turned off in Settings > Memory.
quote: or turn memory off in Settings > Memory

claim: Wearables sharing to Apple Health become available; some proprietary scores may not transfer.
quote: Available information varies by app and metric, and some proprietary scores may not transfer.

claim: Health is rolling out on Android, desktop and dots and may not be available for every account yet.
quote: Health in ChatGPT is rolling out on Android, desktop, and in dots.

claim: Help article: eligible, logged-in Free, Go, Plus and Pro users in the U.S.
quote: Health is available to eligible, logged-in ChatGPT Free, Go, Plus, and Pro users in the U.S.

claim: Help article: supported on web, iOS, Android and the desktop app.
quote: It is supported on web, iOS, Android, and the ChatGPT desktop app.

claim: Apple Health requires an iPhone; Health Connect requires an Android device.
quote: Connecting Apple Health requires an iPhone. Connecting Health Connect requires an Android device.

claim: Apple Health is connectable on iOS mobile only.
quote: Apple Health (iOS mobile only)

claim: Health Connect is connectable on Android mobile only.
quote: Health Connect (Android mobile only)

claim: Supported U.S. provider portals are connectable.
quote: Supported U.S. provider portals

claim: One Medical and Function Health are connectable.
quote: One Medical and Function Health

claim: Parents may turn Health off for linked teen accounts.
quote: Parents may choose to turn Health access off for linked teen accounts.

claim: Users choose the data categories to share when connecting Apple Health or Health Connect.
quote: choose the data categories you want to share

claim: Help article names WHOOP, Oura, Garmin, Strava and MyFitnessPal as apps to set up to share with Apple Health or Health Connect.
quote: If you use a wearable, fitness app, or nutrition app (like WHOOP, Oura, Garmin, Strava, or MyFitnessPal), make sure it’s set up to share data with Apple Health or Health Connect.

claim: Help article: ChatGPT defaults to the global plugins permission setting.
quote: ChatGPT defaults to your global plugins permission setting.

claim: Help article: the unchanged default permission setting is Allow low-risk actions.
quote: If you make no changes to your Plugins settings, the default permission setting is “ Allow low-risk actions ”.

claim: Health permissions are changed in Settings > Plugins > Health.
quote: You can change your Health permissions later in Settings > Plugins > Health.

claim: Typing @Health asks ChatGPT to use Health to personalize a response.
quote: you can add ‘@Health’ to your message to indicate that you’d like to use Health to personalize a response

claim: ChatGPT may provide proactive updates when new records sync or a new trend is detected.
quote: ChatGPT may also use connected data to provide proactive updates

claim: iOS read access is checked in Settings > Apps > Health > Data Access & Devices > ChatGPT, per data category.
quote: Check that read access is enabled for the data categories you want to share.

claim: No write-back to Apple Health, Health Connect or other connected accounts, and no editing of provider records.
quote: ChatGPT cannot edit records held by your healthcare provider or write information to Apple Health, Health Connect, or another connected account.

claim: Profile updates only change the Health profile in ChatGPT.
quote: only change your Health profile in ChatGPT

claim: Disconnecting deletes synced data from OpenAI's systems within 30 days.
quote: When you disconnect an account, data synced from that source is deleted from OpenAI’s systems within 30 days.

claim: Conversation history remains until those conversations are deleted.
quote: Information already included in your ChatGPT conversation history remains until you delete those conversations.

claim: Apple Health and Health Connect are disconnected via Manage then Disconnect.
quote: To disconnect Apple Health or Health Connect

claim: Medical records accounts are removed with Remove account.
quote: Select Remove account .

claim: Memories are not created directly from synced data.
quote: Memories are not created directly from data synced in Health.

claim: Help article: Temporary Chat or turn memory off in Settings > Personalization.
quote: you can use Temporary Chat or turn memory off in Settings > Personalization

claim: Legacy Health Project memories are contained to that project.
quote: memories in the Health Project are contained to that project

claim: Help article: synced data is not used to train foundation models or target ads.
quote: is not used to train our foundation models or target ads

claim: Help article: model improvement settings determine whether conversations that reference Health data can be used to improve models.
quote: Your model improvement settings determine whether conversations that reference your connected Health data, and content derived from that data, can be used to improve our models.

claim: Help article names the toggle Improve the model for everyone in Settings > Data Controls.
quote: you can turn off “Improve the model for everyone” in Settings > Data Controls

claim: ChatGPT only sees what the app shares through Apple Health, Health Connect or another source.
quote: ChatGPT only sees information that the app shares through Apple Health, Health Connect, or another connected source.

claim: App-specific metrics such as a sleep score may not be shared or may be calculated differently.
quote: Some app-specific metrics, for example a sleep score or leaderboard position, may not be shared or may be calculated differently.

claim: Health does not offer a Business Associate Agreement.
quote: Health in ChatGPT is not intended for clinical or covered-entity use and does not offer a Business Associate Agreement.

claim: Privacy Notice: Connected Health Accounts are medical providers, Apple Health and Android Health Connect.
quote: These third parties include medical providers, Apple Health, and Android Health Connect

claim: Privacy Notice: connected accounts let ChatGPT use records, lab results, prescriptions and vital signs.
quote: Connected Health Accounts allow ChatGPT to use connected medical records, lab and test results, prescription information, measurements of vital signs

claim: Privacy Notice: Health is only available to certain users.
quote: Health in ChatGPT is only available to certain users at this time.

claim: Privacy Notice: OpenAI does not train foundation models or target ads on synced data.
quote: We do not train our foundation models or target ads on data synced via Connected Health Accounts.

claim: Privacy Notice: conversations referencing connected data may be used to improve models depending on settings.
quote: To help make ChatGPT a more capable health assistant, conversations that reference Connected Health Accounts data, and content derived from it, may be used to improve our models depending on your ChatGPT settings.

claim: Privacy Notice points to Settings > Data Controls for model improvement.
quote: You can review or turn off model improvement at any time in Settings → Data Controls.

claim: Privacy Notice: memories can be created from conversations that use Connected Health Accounts.
quote: conversations you have that use Connected Health Accounts can create memories to personalize future chats

claim: Privacy Notice lists model training of conversations and memories among user choices.
quote: whether conversations and memories are used to improve and train the foundational models that power ChatGPT

claim: Privacy Notice updated November 19, 2026.
quote: Updated: November 19, 2026

claim: January beta post: OpenAI partners with b.well for U.S. healthcare providers.
quote: To enable access to trusted U.S. healthcare providers, we partner with b.well
